name: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
narrative.objectives: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade.I've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.
